name: pasli-zemin
description: MCP management, semantic memory engine, and security auditing for Claude Code environment setup.

tools.name: mcp_list
tools.description: List all configured MCP servers (claude-code, project, claude-desktop targets)

tools.name: mcp_add
tools.description: Add a new MCP server with name, command, and optional arguments

tools.name: security_audit
tools.description: Scan for token leaks, permission issues, and security vulnerabilities. Optionally auto-remediate with --fix flag

tools.name: memory_note
tools.description: Add a semantic memory note with automatic embedding and knowledge graph linking

tools.name: memory_index
tools.description: Index global memory Markdown notes into the searchable database (run before memory_search)

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search semantic memory and knowledge base with cosine similarity matching

tools.name: status
tools.description: Real-time health check of Claude Code environment (git, python, node, mcp config)

tools.name: test
tools.description: Run comprehensive test suite for deployment verification

tools.name: governor_trim
tools.description: Perform an immediate RAM trim and QoS priority boost across AI tools and builders to prevent system freezing

tools.name: sync_all
tools.description: Synchronize MCP configurations and apply Bun runtime optimization across all 4 AI environments (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, OpenAI Codex, Antigravity)

tools.name: workiq_status
tools.description: Check Windows Work IQ / Microsoft 365 Graph authentication and endpoints status

tools.name: workiq_search
tools.description: Search corporate Microsoft 365 data (emails, OneDrive documents, calendar)

tools.name: workiq_agenda
tools.description: Get upcoming Microsoft 365 calendar events and meetings

tools.name: workiq_recent_files
tools.description: Get recently accessed Microsoft 365 / OneDrive documents

home_dir.title: Home Directory
home_dir.description: Custom home directory override for config file paths. Leave blank to use system $HOME

long_description: Paslı Zemin is a production-ready Rust CLI for managing MCP servers, semantic memory, and security compliance in your Claude Code environment. Features include: (1) Dynamic MCP management with support for three config targets (claude-code ~/.claude.json, project ./.mcp.json, claude-desktop); (2) Semantic memory engine with FastEmbed multilingual embeddings and automatic knowledge graph construction; (3) Security auditing with token scanning, permission enforcement, and pre-commit hook installation; (4) Real-time diagnostics and test suite for deployment verification.
